snippet.title: Sneaky Squad | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam : https://store.steampowered.com/app/5157620/Sneaky_Squad/

Your friends are hiding among identical soldiers. One wrong move gives them away. 😂

Sneaky Squad is a multiplayer game of blending in, fooling your friends, and trying not to panic when the Seeker looks your way.

Blend in. Follow commands. Don’t get caught.
